description: Test suite for the SettingsNetworkingHelpers utility functions related to parsing host/port strings and formatting URLs.

classes.name: SettingsNetworkingHelpersTests
classes.description: Test suite struct for testing networking helper functions, including parsing host and port strings and formatting URLs.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesIPv4
methods.description: Tests that IPv4 addresses with port are correctly parsed into host and port components.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesHostnameAndTrims
methods.description: Ensures hostnames with surrounding whitespace are correctly trimmed and parsed.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Checks that IPv6 addresses in brackets with port are correctly parsed.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsMissingPort
methods.description: Verifies that missing port returns nil.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsInvalidPort
methods.description: Confirms that invalid port values return nil.

methods.name: httpURLStringFormatsIPv4AndPort
methods.description: Tests that IPv4 addresses and ports are formatted correctly into URLs.

methods.name: httpURLStringBracketsIPv6
methods.description: Checks that IPv6 addresses are correctly formatted with brackets in URLs.

methods.name: httpURLStringLeavesAlreadyBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Ensures IPv6 addresses already in brackets are not altered.

methods.name: httpURLStringFallsBackWhenMissingHostOrPort
methods.description: Tests fallback URL generation when host or port is missing.
